name: Ruth Stabile
career_history: Chief Estimator at Mortenson, 1/2024 to present; Senior Preconstruction and Estimating Manager at JE Dunn Construction, 3/2019 to 1/2024; Senior Estimator at JE Dunn Construction, 5/2015 to 3/2019; Senior Estimator/ Director Of Preconstruction at i2 Construction, 7/2014 to 5/2015; Senior Estimator at Sachse Construction, 12/2013 to 6/2014; Senior Estimator at Barton Malow, 6/2005 to 2/2013; Concrete Estimator/ Lead Estimator at Barton Malow, 2/2002 to 6/2005; Estimator/ Project Manager at Angelo Iafrate Construction, 5/1999 to 2/2002; Field Engineer at OHM Advisors, 9/1996 to 5/1999; Field Technician at SMEUSA, 5/1994 to 9/1995
notes: Works at an adjacent-industry company (GC / energy / civil / industrial); re-imported 2026-09-09 at Siddhi's request.
education: Bachelor of Science, Civil Engineering, Michigan State University, 1991 to 1996
biography:
I'm proud to be a part of Mortenson, a company that builds for the greater good, supporting our customer's success and impacting their industries. As chief estimator, being in the position to lead the estimating process for new projects - including estimating standards and procedures - allows us to ensure our estimating team is aligned from top to bottom.

With over 25 years in the industry, I have established standardized procedures, methods, and processes for estimating, as well as training estimating resources. In addition, I have been a key leader in self-perform work which has strengthened companies' ability to provide certainty of delivery with concrete, civil and carpentry capabilities.

Outside of work, I'm passionate about animal rescue, particularly fostering dogs. Over the years, I've fostered over 60 dogs, many of which were on euthanasia lists. Seeing these animals transform from scared and unsure to loved and cherished members of a family is deeply rewarding.
